## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- StockAllowanceEngine
- calculates stock for 50mm steel part
- raw stock = finished + 2× total allowance
- larger part needs more allowance
- adds grinding allowance for tight tolerance
- no grinding for loose tolerance without HT
